name: intent
what: Something we want changed that needs your Gate A: its problem, claims, checkpoints, questions for you and its history.

fields.name: problem
fields.means: who, what they experience, evidence, whys to the root, truths, assumptions, risk

fields.name: claims
fields.means: promises, each with how it could fail and its check

fields.name: checkpoints
fields.means: smallest slices, each with its claims

fields.name: tasks
fields.means: what is left, each with its step, what it is for and who does it; its status is computed from the events that name it (done once an event of what done does)

fields.name: questions
fields.means: what only you can answer, asked in chat

fields.name: events
fields.means: the trace, append-only: when, who, what, how, the docs it wrote (writes) and the sources it read or tried to (reads), and a line of text; the step is computed from the events before it

fields.name: design notes (pixel_diff and the like)
fields.means: how a part of the plan works, step by step, where a claim alone would not say it

trace.author: human and agent
trace.note: Its own events are its trace; its source is your words.
trace.reflection: Every new one is checked against the ones of its type that hold and says what it supersedes or merges; it is revised in place, each revision an event in the trace.
